work_order_rule: Authorised S.I.R.E. / HORIZON / GENESIS tools may act only with real access and existing permissions; no new agents are created.
truth: No work item is verified initially. A folder or plan is not runtime proof.

phases.name: Decide and secure the foundation
phases.gate: Owner records gameplay scope, authorised toolchain, rights and canonical roster decisions.

phases.name: Build a functional local combat prototype
phases.gate: One player can move, aim, use abilities and interact with a greybox arena in a real Godot build.

phases.name: Complete a local three-role vertical slice
phases.gate: Tank, DPS and support prototypes complete a match with observable objectives, score, HUD and regression proof.

phases.name: Prove real multiplayer
phases.gate: Two or more separate clients complete a match with server-authoritative validation and failure recovery.

phases.name: Replace approved placeholders with production-quality art and content
phases.gate: Approved models, animations, VFX and at least one polished arena pass Blender-to-Godot import and visual review.

phases.name: Reach stable alpha
phases.gate: Feature slice is stable, accessible, measurable, reproducible and securely testable on selected targets.

phases.name: Qualify beta candidates
phases.gate: Release candidates pass platform, security, performance, load, user acceptance and rollback gates.

phases.name: Release only with explicit owner approval
phases.gate: Approved, signed, reproducible release and validated rollback/operations runbook.

phases.name: Operate, fix and grow safely
phases.gate: Live issues, hotfixes, balance changes and content updates follow evidence-backed controlled releases.

work_items.title: Lock core genre, player camera, team size, match rules and supported target platforms
acceptance: Owner-approved design decision record names the game loop, local/online MVP, control/camera mode, team size, win condition, target devices and performance budget.
required_evidence: Signed decision record and owner approval link.

work_items.title: Establish asset permissions, licensing and protection policy
acceptance: Document source provenance, third-party asset licence review, canonical art lock authority, credits and protected photographs; retain approved original work.
required_evidence: Rights ledger with approvals and traceable source references.

work_items.title: Reconcile character roster and aliases
acceptance: Confirm exact canonical hero names, roles and approval status, including ThornDell, Korvex/Corvex, Razor and Raven; never silently create or rename IDs.
required_evidence: Approved character register diff and canonical reference links.

work_items.title: Reproduce development environment and backup
acceptance: Pin Godot 4.7.2 workflow and approved Blender version, verify clone/import/boot, clean caches, Git LFS decision and restoration instructions.
required_evidence: Version outputs, successful actual engine log and backup restoration notes.

work_items.title: Extend CI and preflight checks
acceptance: Every PR runs structure, task-plan, Python adversarial and genuine native Godot headless tests; failures prevent claiming verification.
required_evidence: Workflow run and exact commit SHA.

work_items.title: Define data contracts, version rules and safe migrations
acceptance: Write schemas for stable hero IDs, abilities, modes and balance and how to migrate resources without breaking Godot UIDs or saved data.
required_evidence: Reviewed schema plus invalid/upgrade fixture tests.

work_items.title: Implement device input and camera controller
acceptance: Real playable controller reads configured input, handles camera movement and input focus loss; scripted tests cover key binding paths.
required_evidence: Actual Godot movement/camera video and input test log.

work_items.title: Implement player movement, collision and navigation basics
acceptance: Gravity, ground movement, obstacles, slopes, jump/dash if approved and respawn placement work within a real Godot scene.
required_evidence: Gameplay test footage and collision regression results.

work_items.title: Implement damage, health, shields and death state
acceptance: Damage types and friendly-fire policy use validated values; death and health restoration never double-trigger.
required_evidence: Automated state-machine tests and native engine run.

work_items.title: Implement aiming, hit detection and primary attacks
acceptance: Aiming, cooldowns, collision and hit reporting are deterministic enough for defined test cases; no unvalidated client damage path.
required_evidence: Hit/miss test cases and native combat capture.

work_items.title: Implement versioned hero/ability Resources
acceptance: Godot editor can load approved typed hero and ability definitions; unknown IDs and invalid data fail clearly.
required_evidence: Godot import log and malformed-resource tests.

work_items.title: Implement reusable ability execution, targeting and cooldowns
acceptance: Ability runtime applies cost, cooldown, range and interruption rules and rejects invalid targets.
required_evidence: Ability unit/integration logs and native capture.

work_items.title: Build a collision-safe greybox arena and spawn points
acceptance: One greybox arena has navigable routes, team spawns, collision, camera-safe sight lines and a measurable performance baseline.
required_evidence: Actual Godot arena screenshots and collision validation.

work_items.title: Build basic debug HUD and combat telemetry
acceptance: In-engine debug display shows health, cooldown, hits, errors and frame time without exposing private data.
required_evidence: Real HUD screenshot and test logs.

work_items.title: Make deterministic smoke/regression scenes
acceptance: An actual Godot test harness reproduces movement, damage, cooldown and win/loss primitive assertions on CI.
required_evidence: Genuine Godot test output tied to a commit.

work_items.title: Build one approved tank gameplay kit
acceptance: A selected approved tank has its own movement, survivability, ability identity and counterplay; no unapproved shield duplication.
required_evidence: Godot gameplay capture, unique kit specification and automated hit/ability tests.

work_items.title: Build one approved DPS gameplay kit
acceptance: An approved DPS prototype has defined pressure, mobility and unique cooldowns; design brief is not mislabelled as a production model.
required_evidence: Godot gameplay capture and ability balance test results.

work_items.title: Build one approved support gameplay kit
acceptance: An approved support prototype heals/buffs/controls as signed off, targets allies/enemies correctly and has meaningful counters.
required_evidence: Godot gameplay capture and ally-target/effect regression tests.

work_items.title: Build hero-selection and in-match HUD
acceptance: Player can select each permitted hero and see health, abilities, cooldown, team markers, clear feedback and focus navigation.
required_evidence: Native UI interaction video and accessibility checks.

work_items.title: Implement team assignments and friendly/hostile rules
acceptance: Two team assignments drive alliance, target, healing, spawning and damage rules; no cross-team leakage.
required_evidence: Team rule unit/integration tests.

work_items.title: Implement one playable match mode and scoreboard
acceptance: Match transitions warmup, active play, scoring, win/loss, restart and clean scene exit without orphaned state.
required_evidence: Full genuine local match video and reproducible rules tests.

work_items.title: Build repeatable local bot/test harness
acceptance: Basic test agents or scripted inputs execute a complete match repeatably and flag crashes/invalid scores.
required_evidence: Replay trace and CI integration log.

work_items.title: Complete first-play tutorial and control discoverability
acceptance: New player can learn objectives, inputs, hero role and quit/retry using keyboard/controller path where approved.
required_evidence: Moderated local test notes and genuine UI capture.

work_items.title: Accept local vertical-slice gate
acceptance: Three role prototypes, one mode, one arena, HUD and match end-to-end work on native Godot with blockers recorded.
required_evidence: Exact commit, independent full match video, regression report and review approval.

work_items.title: Approve networking and trust model
acceptance: Owner-approved dedicated/server-host choice, authority rules, replication budget, region/ping targets and privacy/data-handling decisions are documented.
required_evidence: Threat model, protocol decision record and workload budget approval.

work_items.title: Implement authoritative server and state replication
acceptance: Server validates damage, abilities, movement and match outcomes; two clients observe consistent state; no client-trusted rewards.
required_evidence: Two-client trace with server logs and invalid-client test.

work_items.title: Implement interpolation, prediction and latency policy
acceptance: Measured latency/jitter cases handle interpolation and correction without allowing advantage from invalid clients.
required_evidence: Network simulation measurements and native two-client video.

work_items.title: Implement join, leave, reconnect and match recovery
acceptance: Disconnect/rejoin/timeout/host loss scenarios resolve without duplicated actors, score corruption or stuck lobby.
required_evidence: Real disconnect/reconnect scenario log and screenshot/video.

work_items.title: Test authority, malicious packets and anti-abuse boundaries
acceptance: Invalid input, replay, rate abuse, impossible damage and unauthenticated requests fail safely and are logged without exposing secrets.
required_evidence: Adversarial test report and redacted server logs.

work_items.title: Accept genuine multiplayer vertical slice
acceptance: Two independent clients complete a match at configured latency with server authority, join/quit recovery and protected secrets.
required_evidence: Native real multi-client recording, server traces, CI log and signed acceptance.

work_items.title: Evaluate deployment, hosting and matchmaking costs
acceptance: Provide capacity model, server costs, regional/data options and matchmaking proposal; no paid service or deployment without owner approval.
required_evidence: Cost estimate, privacy review and approval decision.

work_items.title: Ingest and lock authorised original concept sources
acceptance: All approved visual source references have provenance/version, file hash and exact canonical sheet; source paths are not overwritten.
required_evidence: Source manifest, rights/approval record and hashes.

work_items.title: Model blockouts and approved hero meshes in Blender
acceptance: One tank, DPS and support have editable Blender models, topology and distinct silhouette conforming to approved art.
required_evidence: Real Blender four-angle renders, topology images, .blend source hashes.

work_items.title: Rig, skin and animate approved character models
acceptance: Selected hero rigs, blend trees and animation clips have verified pose range, clipping, root motion decisions and transitions.
required_evidence: Actual Blender animation video plus rig/skin checks.

work_items.title: Author licensed textures, materials, VFX and audio sources
acceptance: Materials, texture sets, VFX/audio follow art locks, budgets, attribution and rights; sources remain separated from exports.
required_evidence: Asset provenance ledger and original editor captures.

work_items.title: Build tested Blender-to-Godot asset import pipeline
acceptance: Reproducible GLB exports preserve scale, orientation, materials, skeleton, clips, LOD plan and dependencies.
required_evidence: Actual fresh Godot import log, checksum, screenshots and animation playback.

work_items.title: Integrate approved hero visuals without changing gameplay IDs
acceptance: Tank, DPS, support runtime scenes use imported approved models/animations/VFX and maintain hitbox/gameplay correctness.
required_evidence: Genuine before/after engine comparison and gameplay capture.

work_items.title: Produce one optimised arena art and lighting pass
acceptance: Playable arena maintains sight lines, readability, collision, navigational clarity, frame budget and visual identity.
required_evidence: Godot environment screenshots, navigation test and frame-time measurements.

work_items.title: Expand roster and maps by approved, tested increments
acceptance: Every added character and arena has its own spec, provenance, animation/import, balance and multiplayer regression tests.
required_evidence: Per-asset manifest and independent live gameplay evidence.

work_items.title: Balance heroes and match metrics across roles
acceptance: Defined health, cooldowns, mobility and objective contribution receive instrumented matches and documented adjustments.
required_evidence: Balance test matrix, match results and approved change log.

work_items.title: Define and test save/settings persistence contracts
acceptance: Settings and any selected progression save under Godot user:// with version migration, corruption recovery and no sensitive data in source.
required_evidence: Real save/load/restart tests on selected platforms.

work_items.title: Complete accessibility, controller support and settings UI
acceptance: Approved platforms support remapping, contrast, readable HUD, scalable text, captions/feedback and controller/focus navigation.
required_evidence: Accessibility matrix, real control tests and device captures.

work_items.title: Profile target devices, streaming, memory and frame pacing
acceptance: Measured representative scenes meet owner-approved performance targets without hidden quality regressions.
required_evidence: Profiler trace, exact hardware/OS and frame-time/memory report.

work_items.title: Run cross-system gameplay regression and soak tests
acceptance: Match, hero abilities, networking, save/load and state recovery survive repeated tests with failing cases triaged.
required_evidence: CI evidence, long-run logs, failure/repair links.

work_items.title: Run first-player UX and objective clarity playtests
acceptance: Observed users can complete onboarding, select heroes, understand roles/objectives and report accessibility issues.
required_evidence: Consent-aware playtest report with unresolved findings.

work_items.title: Approve privacy-safe crash reporting and operational telemetry
acceptance: Data minimisation, consent, log retention, access control, crash recovery and alerting are approved before real-user collection.
required_evidence: Privacy decision, data flow diagram and redacted simulated logs.

work_items.title: Pass alpha exit gate
acceptance: No unresolved release-blocking crashes/exploits; current scope, screenshots, performance and functional evidence reviewed.
required_evidence: Alpha test report, known issues, native demo and owner gate sign-off.

work_items.title: Prepare reproducible platform builds and protected signing
acceptance: Target exports produce reproducible artefacts with version metadata; signing credentials are external to Git and narrowly authorised.
required_evidence: Build hashes, package installation logs and credential-safety report.

work_items.title: Run multi-device, latency, load and endurance qualification
acceptance: Actual selected devices, network failure cases and load tests meet agreed frame-time, server and recovery budgets.
required_evidence: Device matrix, latency/load graphs, real play footage and issues.

work_items.title: Test upgrades, recovery, storage and backward compatibility
acceptance: Update/reinstall, resume, corrupted user saves and version migration preserve authorised data safely.
required_evidence: Version-to-version install/upgrade logs and recovery tests.

work_items.title: Complete security, privacy, content/IP and distribution review
acceptance: Threat modelling, licensing, content ratings, privacy disclosures, credits, account/child-safety obligations and platform rules reviewed.
required_evidence: Signed review checklist and remediation proof.

work_items.title: Pass beta/release candidate gate
acceptance: Candidate commit passes regression and real target test matrix, has rollback readiness and open issues are classified.
required_evidence: Candidate evidence manifest, risk register and approval record.

work_items.title: Exercise rollback, monitoring and incident procedures
acceptance: A reversible release rehearsal validates alerting, rollback, backup, server safety and versioned builds; do not deploy paid services unapproved.
required_evidence: Dry-run incident record and rollback demonstration.

work_items.title: Prepare accurate store, community and support materials
acceptance: Screenshots and trailers are actual captures or marked concepts; installation, accessibility, known limits and support contacts are correct.
required_evidence: Approved asset/source ledger and store-content review.

work_items.title: Release approved build to authorised channels
acceptance: Explicit owner go/no-go, target checks, signing, rollout and rollback owner documented; only then distribute build.
required_evidence: Owner authorisation, release commit/build hash, deployment proof and launch checklist.

work_items.title: Triage incidents and ship tested hotfixes
acceptance: Every incident has severity, reproduction, fix, regression, capture, rollback and owner communication.
required_evidence: Issue timeline, corrected CI logs, signed patch and incident review.

work_items.title: Operate balance, new content and upgrade pipeline
acceptance: Content/hero/realm updates reuse model/ability/network QA and approved art locks, staged rollout and monitored rollback.
required_evidence: Content change manifests, genuine live tests and release logs.

work_items.title: Review observability, maintenance and continuity
acceptance: Recurring audit of uptime, errors, moderation/safety needs, platform changes, backup restore and incident drills is scheduled by authorised team.
required_evidence: Dated maintenance reports and fresh acceptance results.
